author: KEXP
description: Hailing from San Sebastian, Spain, self-defined "violent-pop" trio Merina Gris bring red-hot intensity to Live on KEXP. Our latest session from Bilbao invites them to share a performance of "lilili" and more.
title: Merina Gris performs "lilili" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
